translation: How could one know that the Fu Zhong Lun (腹中論) says: The Emperor said, 'Master, you have repeatedly said that in heat in the middle (熱中) and wasting in the middle (消中) one must not take fragrant herbs and mineral drugs; mineral drugs bring on dian (癲), fragrant herbs bring on kuang (狂).' The commentary says: Drinking much and urinating frequently is called heat in the middle (熱中). Eating much and urinating frequently is called wasting in the middle (消中).
translator_notes: 腹中論 kept as chapter name; 熱中/消中 rendered 'heat in the middle'/'wasting in the middle'; 癲/狂 rendered 'dian'/'kuang'.
